title: The ALMA survey to Resolve exoKuiper belt Substructures (ARKS): IV. CO gas imaging and overview
question: What is the spectro-spatial distribution, optical depth and mass of CO gas in ARKS debris discs, and is CO detectable in the 13 discs without previous detections?

data.angular_resolution: beams 70-150 mas for 12CO in gas-bearing discs; 130-950 mas in gas-free discs

what.value: Disc geometry (i, PA, r, Δr), stellar masses from continuum MCMC fits

evidence.quote: measured from the best fit parameters derived by MCMC sampling carried out by (cite: SebasARKSpaper)

what.value: Literature 12CO line fluxes, ages and fractional luminosities for population study

evidence.quote: we combine ARKS line fluxes (including 13 upper limits) with any archival discs observed with ALMA with a reported line flux for the $^{12}$CO J=3-2 line

external_data.citation: Archival refs in Table (cite: marino2019gap; marino2018gap; daley2019mass)

evidence.quote: If the ISM $^{12}$C/$^{13}$C abundance ratio of 77 applies, that implies that the $^{12}$CO optical depth must be at least 77

recipe.method: Three-stage tclean with Keplerian masks and multiscale CLEAN to 4 RMS
assumptions: Gas co-located with dust and near-Keplerian

recipe.method: Quadratic fit to peak velocity; peak brightness temperature via Planck; spectro-spatial shifted integrated intensity
key_parameters: clip at 3.5 sigma; integrate channels above 4 sigma

recipe.method: Gofish spectra and shifted-stacked radial profiles in 1/4-beam elliptical annuli; on-sky profiles for edge-on discs; ratio where 13CO >2 sigma

recipe.goal: Search for CO in gas-free discs by stacking
recipe.method: Spectro-spatial shifting/stacking of dirty cubes in both rotation directions; 3 sigma upper limits from 7 km/s bootstrapped windows
assumptions: Keplerian rotation, CO co-located with dust

recipe.method: Integrate stacked spectrum over V*±5 sigma (Gaussian fit); box integration for edge-on; optically thin LTE mass and tau=77 scaling
assumptions: LTE with Tex equal to peak brightness temperature; tau12CO=77 from ISM 12C/13C

recipe.method: Scale fluxes to 100 pc, convert J=2-1 to J=3-2 with ratio 1.67, compare with age and fractional luminosity

evidence.quote: These values (Table [\[tab:linefluxesofgas\]](#tab:linefluxesofgas)) are of order $\sim1-6\times10^{-4}$ M$_{\oplus}$.
intensity ratios at the radial $^{12}$CO intensity peaks of each system are $\sim 2.0 - 5.5$
we measure peak-brightness temperatures of $\sim 25 - 50$ K

answer_key.quantity: Velocity-based upper limits on 12CO inner radius

evidence.quote: We calculated velocity-based upper limits to the inner disc radii of $3 - 68$ au.

answer_key.quantity: Planet mass opening gap in HD 131488 (lower limit)

evidence.quote: We find that a $7 M_\oplus$ planet located at 5.8 au is capable of opening a gap
